summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 1 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: There is a strange rule in my town. Everyone knows it. But nobody talks about it.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 2 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: Never let another person's shadow touch yours.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 3 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: When I was a kid, I thought it was just an old superstition. Something parents told their children to keep them from wandering around at night.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 4 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: Then, one evening, I found out why. I was walking home alone when I noticed someone standing beneath a streetlight ahead of me.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 5 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: I couldn't see his face. He was completely still. As I got closer, he stepped toward me.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 6 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: And for a moment, our shadows moved across the pavement. I tried to walk around him. But he moved with me. Then our shadows touched. Just for a second.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 7 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: I waited for something to happen. Nothing did. The man simply walked away. So I went home.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 8 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: I locked the door. I turned off the lights. And I went to bed. A few minutes later, I noticed something strange. My shadow was still standing in the hallway. The lights were off. There shouldn't have been a shadow at all.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 9 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: I stared at it. It didn't move. Then I took one step backward. The shadow stayed where it was. I took another step. Still nothing. And then… it turned its head toward me. I couldn't breathe. It didn't have a face. Just darkness. But somehow, I knew it was looking directly at me.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 10 (dont-let-the-shadow-touch-you)

data.narration_text: Then it took one step forward. I stepped back. It stepped forward again. And that's when I finally understood what the old people meant. The rule wasn't… "Don't let your shadow touch someone else's." The real rule was… "Don't let something else take your shadow."

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 1 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: Every night at exactly 2:17 AM, a man appears beneath the streetlight outside my house. My neighbor gave me one warning.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 2 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: Never look directly at him. I thought it was just an old superstition. Until I saw him myself. He was tall. Too tall. Completely black. And he never moved.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 3 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: I looked anyway.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 4 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: The streetlight suddenly went out.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 5 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: When it came back… he was closer. I stepped away from the window.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 6 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: The light went out again.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 7 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: When it came back… he was standing directly outside my window. I froze.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 8 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: Then I saw another shadow behind me. I slowly turned around. Nothing. I looked back at the window. There were now two of him. One outside. One standing behind me.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 9 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: That's when I understood the real rule.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 10 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: Looking at him doesn't make him come closer. It tells him where you live. I ran downstairs.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 11 (the-man-under-the-streetlight)

data.narration_text: But when I looked outside… the entire street was filled with them. Hundreds of identical figures. All staring at my house. Then every streetlight went dark. Except the one above my front door.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 1 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: You have trespassed into the Forbidden Archive of Aethelgard. Before you float three ancient, pulsing cores of absolute power. The guardians are awakening, and you must absorb one to escape. But listen closely… true power in this universe always demands a devastating price.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 2 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: The First Core: The Chrono-Tear. It grants you ultimate authority over time.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 3 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: Freeze the entire battlefield or rewind your most fatal mistakes.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 4 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: You become a living god.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 5 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: But the price? Every single time you bend time, you permanently shatter a cherished memory. First, your childhood. Then, the faces of your family. Eventually, you will be the strongest warrior alive… but you won't remember who you are fighting for.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 6 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: The Second Core: The Void-Whisper.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 7 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: Step through the very fabric of reality and become entirely untouchable. Teleport through shadows to assassinate targets without a trace.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 8 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: No prison can hold you. The price? Every jump through the void rips away a fragment of your humanity.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 9 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: You will lose all ability to feel joy, sorrow, or love… slowly turning into a hollow, empty husk drifting in the dark.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 10 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: The Third Core: The Crimson Pulse.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 11 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: The absolute pinnacle of life magic. Instantly heal any fatal wound, regenerate lost limbs, and command the very blood of your enemies.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 12 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: You are immortal. The price? This magic cannot create life; it steals it.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 13 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: To heal yourself, it violently drains the life force of nature around you… and eventually, the life force of the people you swore to protect.

summary: เจนเสียงพากย์ scene 14 (the-forbidden-archive)

data.narration_text: The archive is collapsing! The ceiling is tearing apart! Memory… Emotion… or the lives of the innocent. What will you sacrifice to survive? Choose 1, 2, or 3. Lock your destiny in the comments… before you are buried here forever.
